Dual-row comparison flowchart for EMNLP 2026 paper. Full width, figsize (16, 6) inches, 300 DPI, pure white background. Compares "Standard" (naive global correction) vs "EC-HTE (Ours)" pipeline across 4 stages.

LAYOUT: Two horizontal rows (top = Standard, bottom = EC-HTE) spanning 4 columns (Input → Estimation → Correction → Inference). Column widths: Input 22%, Estimation 26%, Correction 26%, Inference 26%. Row heights: top row ~35%, bottom row ~45%, bottom results strip ~20%. Generous spacing between all boxes (at least 12px gaps). NO TEXT OVERLAP ANYWHERE — this is the #1 priority.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
COLUMN HEADERS (top of figure)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
Four column headers centered above each column, 13pt bold serif (Times New Roman), color #2C3E50:
"Input", "Estimation", "Correction", "Inference"
Thin horizontal line (#E0E0E0, 0.5pt) below headers separating them from content.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ROW LABELS (left margin)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
- Top row label: "Standard" in 11pt bold, color #C0392B, rotated 90° on the left margin
- Bottom row label: "EC-HTE (Ours)" in 11pt bold, color #2980B9, rotated 90° on the left margin

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TOP ROW — "Standard" (rose/red theme)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
Light rose background band (#FADBD8, alpha 0.3) spanning the full width behind the top row.

- ESTIMATION column (top row): Rounded rectangle, white fill, rose border (#C0392B, 1.5pt), rounded 10px, subtle shadow.
  * "Pooled CM  Ĉ" in 11pt bold serif #2C3E50 (Ĉ in math italic with hat)
  * "One matrix for all" in 9pt italic #7F8C8D below
  * Box width ~80% of column, centered

- CORRECTION column (top row): Same rose-bordered style.
  * "Global Correction" in 11pt bold serif #2C3E50
  * "Ĉ⁻¹ applied uniformly" in 9pt italic #7F8C8D below (Ĉ⁻¹ in math)

- INFERENCE column (top row): Rounded rectangle, LIGHT ROSE fill (#FADBD8), rose border (#C0392B, 1.5pt), rounded 10px, shadow.
  * "Sign Reversal  ✗" in 11pt bold #C0392B (✗ = bold red X mark)
  * "14.9% of configs" in 9pt italic #C0392B below

Thin gray arrows (1pt, #BDBDBD, small triangular heads 4pt) connecting boxes left-to-right within the top row.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
BOTTOM ROW — "EC-HTE (Ours)" (blue/teal theme)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
Light blue background band (#D6EAF8, alpha 0.3) spanning the full width behind the bottom row.

- INPUT column (bottom row): TWO stacked boxes with 6px vertical gap:
  * Top box: Rounded rect, white fill, blue border (#2980B9, 1.5pt), rounded 10px, shadow.
    "LLM Annotations" in 10pt bold #2C3E50
    "N noisy labels Ẑ" in 9pt italic #7F8C8D (Ẑ in math italic with hat)
  * Bottom box: Same blue-bordered style.
    "Expert Labels" in 10pt bold #2C3E50
    "n_expert pairs (Z, Ẑ)" in 9pt italic #7F8C8D (Z, Ẑ in math italic)
  * These two boxes together should fit within the Input column without overflow.

- ESTIMATION column (bottom row): Rounded rect, white fill, blue border (#2980B9, 1.5pt), rounded 10px, shadow.
  * "Hierarchical Bayes" in 11pt bold serif #2C3E50
  * "Per-subgroup CMs {Ĉ_s}" in 9pt #2C3E50 (math italic for Ĉ_s)
  * BELOW THE BOX (not inside): "Partial pooling · α₀ via Emp. Bayes" in 8pt italic #9E9E9E
  * Box width ~80% of column, centered

- CORRECTION column (bottom row): Same blue-bordered style.
  * "Per-subgroup Corr." in 11pt bold serif #2C3E50
  * "μ̃_s = Ĉ_s⁻¹ · μ̂_s" in 10pt math #2C3E50 (proper math rendering with tildes and hats)
  * BELOW THE BOX: "κ-guard: κ > 100 → fallback" in 8pt italic #9E9E9E

- INFERENCE column (bottom row): Rounded rect, LIGHT BLUE fill (#D6EAF8), blue border (#2980B9, 1.5pt), rounded 10px, shadow.
  * "Corrected CATE  ✓" in 11pt bold #2980B9 (✓ = bold blue/green check mark)
  * "τ̂(x) ± SE_corr" in 10pt math #2C3E50 (τ̂ in math italic with hat)
  * BELOW THE BOX: "via CausalForestDML" in 8pt italic #9E9E9E

Thin gray arrows (1pt, #BDBDBD, small triangular heads) connecting boxes left-to-right within the bottom row. Also arrows from each Input box going right to the Estimation box.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
BETWEEN ROWS — "prior" annotation and "vs." separator
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
- A thin dashed arrow (#9E9E9E, 0.8pt, dashed) going from the top-row Estimation box (Pooled CM) DOWN to the bottom-row Estimation box (Hierarchical Bayes), labeled "prior" in 9pt italic #9E9E9E next to the arrow.
- Between the two rows in the Inference column: "vs." in 10pt bold #7F8C8D

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
BOTTOM RESULTS STRIP
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
Below the two rows, a thin horizontal divider (#E0E0E0, 0.5pt), then:

- LEFT SIDE: Dark navy rounded rectangle (#2C3E50 fill, white text), rounded 8px, shadow.
  * "0% sign reversal  ·  |bias| ÷ 7.4" in 11pt bold white
  * This box should be about 45% of the figure width

- RIGHT SIDE: Rounded rectangle, white fill, ORANGE border (#E67E22, 1.5pt), rounded 8px, shadow.
  * "Diagnostic (Prop. 5):" in 9pt bold #E67E22
  * "|δ_s| / ((1−2π̄) · π_s) > 1" in 10pt math #2C3E50 (π̄ with overbar, δ_s in math italic)
  * This box should be about 45% of the figure width

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
GLOBAL STYLE (MANDATORY)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (EMNLP 2026) — elegant, premium, sophisticated
- 300 DPI, pure white background #FFFFFF
- Serif font (Times New Roman) for ALL text — NO sans-serif anywhere
- figsize (16, 6) inches — wide format to prevent text overlap
- Drop shadows on ALL major boxes: 2px right+down, 8% black opacity
- Rounded corners 10px on major boxes, 8px on smaller elements
- Arrows: thin 1pt, gray #BDBDBD, small 4pt elegant triangular heads
- Dashed arrow for "prior": 0.8pt, #9E9E9E, dashed pattern
- Colors strictly semantic:
  * Standard/problem row = rose (#FADBD8 fill, #C0392B border/text)
  * EC-HTE/solution row = blue (#D6EAF8 fill, #2980B9 border/text)
  * Neutral = white/light gray (#F5F5F5, #BDBDBD border)
  * Results = dark navy (#2C3E50 fill, white text)
  * Diagnostic = orange border (#E67E22)
  * Annotations/notes = muted gray (#9E9E9E, #7F8C8D)
- NO matplotlib defaults: NO gray background, NO gridlines, NO tab10 colors
- Clean, minimalist, generous whitespace
- All text ≥ 8pt at full figure size (will be ≥ 7pt when scaled to \textwidth)
- CRITICAL: NO TEXT OVERLAP — every text element must have clear space around it
- Box interior padding: at least 8px on all sides
- Vertical spacing between rows: at least 20px
- Mathematical symbols rendered properly: Ĉ (C-hat), μ̃ (mu-tilde), τ̂ (tau-hat), π̄ (pi-bar), δ_s (delta subscript s)
